title: My First Pets Coloring Book (book, cover, KDP listing, Amazon Ads kit)

general-counsel-agent.note: All ten checks on file. Pen name JONNY COLOR keeps the owner anonymous. Nothing commits the owner: no publishing, price or ad spend.

advertising-consumer-protection-counsel.note: Description, A+ points and ad texts checked against the built book: 30 subjects, 64 pages, blank backs and certificate are all true. Headline 3 said 'bunnies' (one bunny inside); fixed to 'A puppy, a kitten, a bunny and more, ages 2-5'.

email-anti-spam-compliance-counsel.note: No commercial email. The delivery goes only to the owner.

privacy-data-protection-counsel.note: No personal data in the book, listing or ads kit.

copyright-fair-use-counsel.note: Art is original vector drawing in art/pets.js; contact sheet reviewed, no copied or licensed characters. Fredoka font is SIL OFL 1.1, which allows embedding. AI-drawn pages can't be registered for US copyright (Thaler v. Perlmutter), so others may copy them.

trademark-brand-clearance-counsel.note: Web search, no USPTO search run (unreachable). DK sells a 'My First Pets' board book in its 'My First' series and Lulu has 'Paris: My First Pet'; no exact 'My First Pets Coloring Book' found. The title is descriptive, matches the series pattern, and uses none of DK's trade dress. Owner may run a USPTO search before publishing. Keywords and ad keywords name no brands or authors.

platform-terms-policy-counsel.note: KDP AI disclosure: answer Yes for images and text, as the listing says. Keywords are 7 phrases of 50 characters or fewer, with no brands or misleading terms. Ad texts and headlines avoid best-seller, sale, price, free and review claims, as Amazon's book ad policy requires; build.js checks passed.

kids-content-coppa-counsel.note: Ages 2-5 content is friendly and safe: no scary or violent images, and nothing pushes purchases on kids. The 'This book belongs to' line collects no data. Fits KDP's children's content guidelines.

contracts-commercial-terms-counsel.note: No contract, quote or terms. The owner publishes and prices on KDP.

fixes: Done: ads headline 3 changed from 'Puppies, kittens and bunnies to color, ages 2-5' to 'A puppy, a kitten, a bunny and more, ages 2-5'.
